feature_contract.goal: Keep complete software Present-frame limiting coherent across initial VR 60-Hz startup fallback, OpenXR xrWaitFrame takeover, unlimited fast loading and live cap switches; prevent stale QPC deadlines from releasing the first returned frame without pacing while preserving steady-state timing and game input.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R84/shared legacy game software limiter transition and its QPC deadline; never change OpenXR xrWaitFrame cadence, normal 60-Hz game simulation, fast-load loader pumping, FFB, SkyGlow, device recovery or DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source-confirmed stale FramelimiterPrevCounter is retained while xrWaitFrame or unlimited loading skips limiter; a return to 60/90 Hz previously compares against an obsolete ideal deadline, causing an unpaced return frame. Startup fallback guards a known white-screen risk, but new Quest3 runtime behavior was not tested.
trace_stages: Original game STATE_START and FastLoad plus Settings::VREnabled and VRFrameCadenceMode decide whether legacy software limiting should own Present.
ReplaceGameUpdateLoop::destination observes xrWaitFrame ownership and effective 60/90 Hz cap, then rebases FramelimiterPrevCounter using QueryPerformanceCounter on the first software-owned frame.
Existing game tick/Present and R84 renderer x86 DLL yield to x64 OpenXR host cadence while fallback retains the original game simulation, input and FFB.
subcomponents: Observe all first-entry, XR takeover, unlimited fast-load and 60-to-90 Hz limit changes in a shared constexpr state helper, rebasing only the first eligible deadline.
Preserve steady-state ideal-time drift correction and unlimited/host-cadenced no-sleep behavior using positive/negative compile-time regression cases in the Windows x86 game source.
Integrate final exact-SHA DX9Ex Active x86 game/x64 host/rollback package plus Domain and source-impact validation without asserting HMD success.

diagnosis.root_cause: Legacy ideal deadline used FramelimiterPrevCounter from a prior software-owned frame even after unlimited or XR-owned Present pauses, so the first capped frame after re-entry can run without pacing.
source_trace: Game mode/VRFrameCadenceMode/FramerateFastLoad compute skipFrameLimiter and effectiveFramerateLimit in ReplaceGameUpdateLoop::destination.
Previously deadline was always FramelimiterPrevCounter plus a cap interval regardless of skipped software-limiter frames.
The material C++ change tracks limiter ownership transitions and rebases the first return's QPC deadline without changing the steady loop.
alternatives_rejected: Restarting every frame would lose the original ideal-timeline correction; overriding XR cadence would double wait and worsen frame timing.
diagnosis.runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR game or HMD session performed; pacing and screen behavior remain untested on real hardware.
